verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents bringing your own Twilio number: Twilio streams call audio to your server, and your server bridges it to the Voice Agent WebSocket. Telephony connectivity for inbound and outbound calls is also claimed, so you are not locked into bundled telephony. However, this requires running your own bridge server, and there is no evidence of native SIP trunking or direct carrier/PBX connection. Missing for 10: native SIP trunk/PBX connectivity, Telnyx or other carrier import, and independent hands-on corroboration.
